# Cards

Surface containers for grouping related content with a featured icon, title, body copy, and optional action footer. Three effect styles (With Shadow, No Shadow, Stroke), three states (Default, Selected, Disabled), three card types (Default, Expandable, Selectable), and full RTL support. Modeled on Figma frame 30195:10358.

**Stylesheet:** `components/cards/cards.css`

**Behaviour:** `js/components/cards.js` (classes `CardManager`); wired through `[data-card-expandable]`, `[data-card-selectable]`. Without it the markup renders but does not open, close or toggle.

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## Props / Configuration

All available CSS classes for composing cards.

| Class | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.card` | CSS class | Base card class. Sets layout, padding, background, radius, and default shadow. |
| `.card-icon` | CSS class | 48×48 circular icon slot using the brand-light background and primary icon color. |
| `.card-content` | CSS class | Vertical stack for the title and body copy. |
| `.card-title` | CSS class | Display heading inside the card. 18/28 bold (Figma text-lg/Bold). |
| `.card-body` | CSS class | Body copy. 16/24 regular (Figma text-md/Regular). |
| `.card-footer` | CSS class | Horizontal action row at the bottom of the card. Hosts .btn elements. |
| `.card-image` | CSS class | Image slot sitting inside the card's padding. 4:3 aspect ratio, radius-md rounded corners. The featured icon, when present, renders as a separate sibling below the image (leading-edge aligned). |
| `.card-custom` | CSS class | Flexible drop-zone slot styled as a primary-tinted dashed panel. Use .card-custom__title and .card-custom__body for its contents. |
| `.card-tags` | CSS class | Row of .tag elements aligned to the trailing edge of the card. |
| `.card-rating` | CSS class | Star rating slot. Holds .card-rating__stars (with five .card-rating__star children using --filled, --half, or no modifier) and a .card-rating__count review count label. |
| `.card-chevron` | CSS class | Chevron-down button positioned at the bottom-trailing corner of an Expandable card. Rotates 180° when .card--expanded is added. |
| `.card-select-indicator` | CSS class | Square checkbox positioned at the top-trailing corner of a Selectable card. Fills with primary when .card--selected is added. |
| `.card--no-shadow` | Modifier | Remove the drop shadow. Adds a neutral primary border in its place. |
| `.card--stroke` | Modifier | Remove the drop shadow and apply a black (Figma border-black) border for maximum emphasis. |
| `.card--expandable` | Modifier | Make the card render with a chevron at the bottom-trailing corner. Default state is collapsed (chevron points down). |
| `.card--expanded` | State | Rotates the chevron 180° to indicate the expanded state. Add via JS when the card is toggled. |
| `.card--selectable` | Modifier | Make the card behave as a toggleable option. Renders a square checkbox at the top-trailing corner. |
| `.card--selected` | State | Fills the checkbox indicator with the primary token and shows a white check. The card border stays neutral per Figma. |
| `.card--disabled` | State | Greyed-out state. Disables pointer events and applies the Figma disabled tokens to background, border, text, and icon. |

## Anatomy

A complete card with all four parts: featured icon, title, body copy, and action footer. Inner gap is 24px (Card/card-lg-gap); padding is 16px (spacing-xl).

```html
<article class="card">
    <div class="card-icon">
        <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
            <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"></path>
            <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"></polyline>
        </svg>
    </div>
    <div class="card-content">
        <h3 class="card-title">Card Title</h3>
        <p class="card-body">Card content placeholder text goes here</p>
    </div>
    <div class="card-footer">
        <button class="btn btn-secondary-outline">Action</button>
        <button class="btn btn-primary">Action</button>
    </div>
</article>
```

## Default Card

A static surface for grouping information. Compose with the icon, content, and footer parts in any combination — all are optional except the base .card wrapper.

## Expandable Card

Same vertical stack as the Default card, with a small chevron at the bottom-trailing corner that indicates the expand direction. Click anywhere on the card or the chevron to toggle .card--expanded. Add real expanded content by appending markup in your own template and showing/hiding it as needed.

</article>

## Selectable Card

A toggleable card with a square checkbox at the top-trailing corner. Default shows an empty box; selected fills the box with the primary token and a white check. The card border itself does not change on selection — only the checkbox. No footer in this variant per Figma. Click either card to toggle.

## Card Grid

Cards work cleanly in a responsive grid using their natural width and CSS grid for the layout. The fixed 360px card width keeps every card the same size; flex-wrap is what makes them flow to the next row at narrower viewports.

```html
<article class="card">
    <div class="card-icon">
        <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
            <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"></path>
            <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"></polyline>
        </svg>
    </div>
    <div class="card-content">
        <h3 class="card-title">First</h3>
        <p class="card-body">A repeating layout works well for paginated content or a small dashboard.
        </p>
    </div>
    <div class="card-footer">
        <button class="btn btn-primary">Open</button>
    </div>
</article>
<article class="card card--no-shadow">
    <div class="card-icon">
        <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
            <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"></path>
            <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"></polyline>
        </svg>
    </div>
    <div class="card-content">
        <h3 class="card-title">Second</h3>
        <p class="card-body">Mix effect styles within a grid for visual rhythm.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="card-footer">
        <button class="btn btn-secondary-outline">Open</button>
    </div>
</article>
<article class="card card--stroke">
    <div class="card-icon">
        <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
            <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"></path>
            <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"></polyline>
        </svg>
    </div>
    <div class="card-content">
        <h3 class="card-title">Third</h3>
        <p class="card-body">The Stroke variant gives a more editorial feel in a quiet grid.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="card-footer">
        <button class="btn btn-primary">Open</button>
    </div>
</article>
```

## RTL Support

All card variants flip cleanly for Arabic. Icon, content, and footer mirror their alignment, and the Selectable indicator moves to the trailing (left) corner because of inset-inline-end.

```html
<article class="card">
    <div class="card-icon">
        <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
            <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"></path>
            <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"></polyline>
        </svg>
    </div>
    <div class="card-content">
        <h3 class="card-title">عنوان البطاقة</h3>
        <p class="card-body">نص محتوى البطاقة يظهر هنا</p>
    </div>
    <div class="card-footer">
        <button class="btn btn-secondary-outline">إجراء</button>
        <button class="btn btn-primary">إجراء</button>
    </div>
</article>
<article class="card card--selectable card--selected">
    <div class="card-select-indicator" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <div class="card-icon">
        <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
            <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"></path>
            <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"></polyline>
        </svg>
    </div>
    <div class="card-content">
        <h3 class="card-title">بطاقة محددة</h3>
        <p class="card-body">حالة محددة مع المؤشر</p>
    </div>
</article>
```
